text:
maria_sales: Hey team — CobaltHealth renewal hits next month. They currently run Dedicated at a $150k annual commit. Customer is asking to rebaseline to a $300k commit and wants a 25% uplift discount off list plus a 24-month term. Need dealdesk + legal flags. @kevin_dealdesk @tiffany_csm

alex_pre_sales: Do we have their trailing 12 usage? I remember big Q4 spikes from their POC.

maria_sales: Last 12mo tokens roughly 110B, but Q4 prod run pushed peak months to ~35B. They expect sustained increase with model expansion.

kevin_dealdesk: Thanks. Two immediate asks from dealdesk: 1) target ARR and discount rationale 2) whether we should gate the discount on a staged commit (e.g., $200k first year, $300k year 2) or full upfront commit.

maria_sales: Their CFO prefers smoothing — will consider staged. They pushed for price protection for model upgrades and lower overage rates.

alex_pre_sales: Technical note: they want dedicated GPU pools pinned to NVLink machines in us-west. Also asking for a private VPC option for HIPAA datasets. That could change pricing.

tiffany_csm: Security questionnaire in progress. They've flagged KMS integration and audit logs retention (7 years). Also requesting SOC2 + HIPAA attestation language in the SOW. Legal will want to weigh in.

liam_finance: Quick calc for modeling: if we provide 25% off list on $300k commit, ARR recognized = $225k. Need to confirm margin impact; any preferred effective date?

maria_sales: They want new pricing to start at renewal date (60 days). Also asking for a limited credit if we miss latency SLO during big batch jobs.

kevin_dealdesk: Drafting a rate exception request. Two approval paths: standard discount ladder (requires Rev Ops signoff) or strategic concession (exec signoff). This looks strategic due to VPC + term. I'll propose staged commit + performance SLA credits.

maria_sales: Putting together a short business case for execs — can someone paste a quick pricing snippet we can show them?

alex_pre_sales: Pasting temporary snippet so execs see order of magnitude:
```
Commit tier    | List price   | Proposed price (25% off)
$150k          | $150,000     | $112,500
$300k          | $300,000     | $225,000
Overage rate   | $/1M tokens   | reduce from $10 to $7.5 on commit
```

kevin_dealdesk: That helps. Add a staged option: Year1 $200k (price $150k after 25% off), Year2 $300k. Also add clause: price protection only for covered models; major model family changes may trigger repricing.

tiffany_csm: FYI: CSM will require a runbook for failover and clear on-call points before we sign. Also needs a 30-day parallel testing window for the VPC migration.

maria_sales: @kevin_dealdesk can you start the deal desk form + mark strategic? I'll attach the CobaltHealth renewal packet once I OCR the docs.

kevin_dealdesk: On it. I'll loop in legal-ops and revops. Expect draft by EOD tomorrow.

dealbot: Reminder — please attach ARR, current contract id, and security exceptions when submitting deal desk request: https://redwood-internal/dealsubmit

liam_finance: One ask from finance: if we go staged, include payment schedule and whether ACH/PO is acceptable.

maria_sales: Noted. I'll confirm payment terms with customer this afternoon.

alex_pre_sales: Also pinging infra about NVLink capacity in us-west before we promise pinned nodes — cc @infra (not in thread).

tiffany_csm: I'll keep the security thread updated. If legal needs a redline to SOC2 clause, send to me and I'll coordinate.

kevin_dealdesk: Closing checklist for draft: business case, T12 usage, proposed staged pricing, SLA credit matrix, security exceptions, payment terms. Will flag as exec-review.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post the renewal packet and customer's latest security questionnaire here when I have it. :thumbsup:

alex_pre_sales: Good plan. If execs ask for unit economics, I can provide token-level cost breakdown vs. expected throughput.

maria_sales: Last note — customer asked for a short POC extension to validate the VPC path. Can we offer a 30-day free test environment with limited token cap? Asking now so we can include in SOW.

kevin_dealdesk: We can, but mark as conditional on signature and commit. I'll include in the draft as "30-day validation environment with 10M token cap".

maria_sales: Perfect — thanks team.
